name: inertiaUpload
tagline: Bridge Inertia multipart visits to Upload progress, cancellation, retry and error recovery.

name: FormRoot
tagline: Client or server-adapted forms with shared layout, validation, submission, reset and error recovery.

name: FormFieldControl
tagline: Bind a typed field to RHF or a server adapter, with shared FormField presentation and validation.

name: FormFieldArray
tagline: Dynamic typed field collections with stable keys, nested validation and append/remove/reorder operations.

name: useZodForm
tagline: Create a typed React Hook Form instance with Zod validation; reuse reset, setValue, trigger, formState and field errors.

name: CardBar
tagline: Inline card toolbar with scoped inset and divider edges.

name: TimeRangePicker
tagline: Ordered time range with optional endpoints and canonical native fields.

name: VisuallyHidden
tagline: Accessible supporting text without a visible layout box.

name: RangeTimeline
tagline: Horizontal intervals with token-owned geometry and optional endpoint editing.

name: PageContainer
tagline: Mandatory page shell — EVERY page wraps its content in PageContainer (title/subtitle/extra/footer/breadcrumb).

name: EditorialSection
tagline: One full-width band of an editorial page (gh#1435): put it straight inside `CenteredShell preset="public-landing" flow="sections"`.

name: EditorialHero
tagline: The opening of an editorial page (gh#1435): a copy column — kicker, the page's one h1, a lead, a search and a line of suggested queries — beside a media column.

name: Eyebrow
tagline: The small uppercase kicker above an editorial heading (gh#1435), led by a short ornament rule (`variant="ruled"`, default) or bare (`"plain"`).

name: EditorialBreadcrumb
tagline: The trail at the top of an editorial page (gh#1437): `Breadcrumb` (same `<nav>`/`<ol>`, `aria-current` on the last item, router `linkComponent`) with the editorial rhythm — top inset, gap and line height from `--editorial-breadcrumb-*`.

name: EditorialArticle
tagline: The reading column of a long-form editorial page (gh#1440): the ruled kicker, the page's one h1, an intro set off by a rule, then `EditorialArticleSection`s (an h2 and paragraphs at the reading leading), an `EditorialNote` and a trailing `EditorialTextLink`.

name: EditorialPanel
tagline: A bordered panel with a short tag, a heading and a list (gh#1440) — a roadmap group.

name: EditorialPageHeader
tagline: The intro of an editorial listing page (gh#1437): an optional `EditorialBreadcrumb`, then the ruled kicker, the page's one h1, one lead line, and an action at the end of the title row.

name: EditorialSectionHead
tagline: A section's head (gh#1435): kicker, an editorial h2, one line of description and a trailing action on the title's row — usually an `EditorialTextLink` "view all →" (an inline-flex link with a trailing arrow, `asChild` for a router link).

name: EditorialSearch
tagline: The inset site search (gh#1435): ONE bordered box holding a search glyph, the field and the submit button, under a visually hidden label that also names the `role="search"` landmark.

name: EditorialPillNav
tagline: A horizontal band of section links (gh#1435) — a site's "browse by game" row: an optional lead label, then `EditorialPillNavItem`s (an icon or a small `"dot"` marker; `aria-current="page"` on the link marks the current one).

name: CardShowcase
tagline: A staged composition of product pictures (gh#1435).

name: EditorialBanner
tagline: A rounded brand panel inside the column (gh#1435): kicker, title, description and a call to action beside a media slot, in the inverse palette.

name: CatalogCard
tagline: A catalog tile (gh#1435): the framed picture with an overlaid circular favourite toggle, then an overline, the title (a heading wrapping the item link, clamped to two lines), a metadata row with `CatalogCardTag`s, a price caption and line (price + change), and a footer row.

name: EditorialCard
tagline: A whole-card link (gh#1435).

name: EditorialMasthead
tagline: A public site's header row (gh#1435) for CenteredShell's `topbar` slot: the logo, primary navigation (`EditorialMastheadLink`; `aria-current="page"` underlines the current one) and end actions (the kit `Select variant="borderless" width="auto"` for the interface language or the display currency — the masthead sizes its trigger, `EditorialMastheadAction` 44px icon controls, `variant="outline"` for the account).

name: EditorialFooter
tagline: A public site's footer content (gh#1435) for `CenteredShell footerTone="inverse"`: logo and tagline, link groups (a heading + links each), and a bottom row with the rights line and a note.

name: EditorialFilterBar
tagline: A row of underlined filter toggles above a collection (gh#1435): a named `role="group"` of `aria-pressed` buttons (one pressed at a time) and a trailing note, over a hairline.

name: EditorialToggleGroup
tagline: One-of-N toggles of the editorial account family (gh#1439): a named `role="group"` of `aria-pressed` buttons.

name: EditorialFilterPanel
tagline: A catalog's filter panel (gh#1438): one bordered surface of `EditorialFilterField`s that wrap, bottom aligned, and a trailing `action` (a reset button), as a named `role="group"`.

name: EditorialFilterField
tagline: One field of an EditorialFilterPanel (gh#1438): a visible label (600, muted) over one control; `htmlFor` names the control.

name: CatalogDetail
tagline: The head of a catalog item's page (gh#1438): a framed picture with the save toggle over its corner and a caption, beside the kicker, the page's h1, a row of CatalogDetailTags, a summary price between hairlines, actions and a two-column facts list.

name: CatalogDetailTag
tagline: One outlined tag (number, rarity, printed language) in a CatalogDetail meta row (gh#1438).

name: CatalogDetailSection
tagline: One band of an item page under its head (gh#1438): a top hairline, an h2, a muted paragraph, then anything else.

name: PriceSummary
tagline: A joined strip of headline figures (gh#1438): one bordered surface split by hairlines, each cell a label, a figure in the number face and a caption, with an optional wider context cell on the subtle ground.

name: EditorialPrompt
tagline: A polite inline invitation (gh#1438): a round glyph, a heading, a short paragraph and a note, with one action at the end ("sign in to see more").

name: EditorialTextButton
tagline: An underlined text action in the primary tone (gh#1439): "Reset display preferences", "Your collection →".

name: EditorialMetaBar
tagline: A hairline-ruled strip under a page header (gh#1439): a glyph and a line at the start ("Your private collection"), a badge at the end.

name: EditorialEmptyPanel
tagline: A centred panel for a signed-out or an empty state (gh#1439).

name: EditorialStats
tagline: A strip of figure tiles on unequal tracks (gh#1439, default `1.4fr 1fr 1fr`): label, large tabular figure with a small unit, optional note.

name: EditorialToolbar
tagline: The row above a collection (gh#1438, gh#1439): an optional `summary` (result count as a polite live region + a short note), a start cluster (an EditorialToggleGroup filter) and an end cluster (order Select, view switch, primary action), optionally over a hairline (`divider`).

name: HoldingGrid
tagline: The track of HoldingCards (gh#1439): `view="grid"` lays tiles on `--editorial-holding-grid-track-size` (default four columns); `view="list"` turns the same cards into wide rows (`140px 1fr`, body on `1.5fr 1fr 140px`).

name: HoldingCard
tagline: One owned item (gh#1439): a picture ground (the consumer's link around an image), overline, title, meta, outlined tags (the last set apart), the purchase line, a date and HoldingCardActions.

name: HoldingCardAction
tagline: A quiet glyph + label action of a HoldingCard (gh#1439): edit, remove.

name: SettingsLayout
tagline: A settings page (gh#1439): a sticky rail (`aside`, default 260px, `--editorial-settings-layout-aside-inset` from the top) beside the panels, gap 64px.

name: SettingsPanel
tagline: One bordered settings section (gh#1439): a number in the figure face beside the title and its description, then the fields (a Form).

name: ThemePicker
tagline: An illustrated radio group for the colour theme (gh#1439): each choice is a painted preview of the interface — light, dark, or the system split — over its glyph and label.

name: EditorialAuth
tagline: A sign-in / sign-up page (gh#1439): a story column (kicker, display title — line breaks kept —, copy, a decorative card pair carrying `art`, benefit lines with a check) beside the form card (`children`, default 460px).

name: EditorialAuthCard
tagline: The form card of EditorialAuth (gh#1439): badge, title, copy, the form (`children`) and a ruled footer line ("New to the site? Create an account").

name: EditorialFootnote
tagline: A quiet closing line under a collection or a settings form (gh#1439): a muted note at the start and an optional action (an EditorialTextButton) at the end.

name: PageCover
tagline: A page's cover image (gh#1160): Notion's banner across the top, or note.com's eyecatch (~1.91:1, rounded) in the reading column.

name: Flex
tagline: Token-spaced flex primitive with explicit direction, alignment, justification, and wrapping controls — and, with `attached`, a row of controls welded into ONE visual unit (antd Space.Compact).

name: ResponsiveGrid
tagline: Container-responsive card grid with configurable base, sm, md and lg columns.

name: AppShell
tagline: Root application shell — composes sidebar, topbar rail, main content area, and optional footer.

name: CenteredShell
tagline: The centred root shell, two shapes: `variant="page"` (default) — authenticated, no-sidebar, centred-column page (hosted-ID My Page / account / standalone settings) with a padded topbar; `variant="auth"` / `"auth-canonical"` — the unauthenticated login/mfa/reset shell (brand bar + vertically centred auth card + footer).

name: MobileShell
tagline: Handheld app shell (gh#354) — status band · app bar · the ONE scroll region · sticky action bar · bottom tab bar, with device safe-area insets and a document that never scrolls.

name: Sidebar
tagline: Data-driven vertical nav rail with collapsible submenu groups and a collapsed icon-only mode — never build nav manually with raw buttons.

name: Topbar
tagline: A PURE SLOT bar for the app shell — positions three clusters (start / center / end) and owns ONLY the bar layout.

name: TopbarItem
tagline: ONE interactive cell of a Topbar slot — the account button, a settings or notifications trigger.

name: TopbarSearch
tagline: The bar's one search box.

name: NavList
tagline: Vertical route navigation for INSIDE a page — the shape a settings nav takes.

name: MasterDetail
tagline: Responsive master-detail composition: a fluid list beside a token-owned 300px/320px fixed rail, with a themeable collapse threshold.

name: DraggablePanel
tagline: A floating surface the person using it can MOVE — drag it by the title-bar handle, or focus the handle and nudge it with the arrow keys.

name: SplitPane
tagline: Two-column layout with a main content area and a fixed-width aside panel.

name: ErrorSurface
tagline: Package-owned semantic exception surface for 400 / 403 / 404 / 500 / 503.

name: LegalDocumentShell
tagline: Long-form legal/policy document surface (terms, privacy, DPA, cookie policy, SLA) — semantic article/nav/section landmarks, real anchors, a sticky table-of-contents rail, scroll-spy aria-current, hash deep links with a token-driven scroll offset and focus handoff.

name: Breadcrumb
tagline: Standalone breadcrumb nav rendering an ordered trail of page segments.

name: FloatButton
tagline: Ant Design's corner action, ported whole — a control pinned to the viewport above the page, with FloatButton.Group (a stack, or a menu behind one trigger) and FloatButton.BackTop.

name: Button
tagline: Core button with variant + size presets, built on cva with the kit's own Slot (asChild).

name: Text
tagline: Typographic primitive — use INSTEAD of a hand-rolled `<span className="text-[13px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">`.

name: Heading
tagline: Section heading sized from the --heading-h* tokens.

name: Link
tagline: antd Typography.Link — an anchor that already carries this library's inline link affordance (underline on hover AND on keyboard focus), plus antd's rel guard for target="_blank".

name: Logo
tagline: The product brand mark — a glyph/identity box, or (with `wordmark`) the full mark + wordmark LOCKUP.

name: Reveal
tagline: The official entrance-motion primitive (staggered fade-up) — reads DS motion tokens and honours prefers-reduced-motion, replacing hand-rolled @keyframes + .app-reveal/.d1..d6 classes.

name: Activity
tagline: The official AMBIENT-motion primitive and the standalone indeterminate indicator (antd `Spin`) — a continuous, unbounded 'something is happening right now, elsewhere' mark (someone typing, a sync running, a response streaming, a recording live).

name: Icon
tagline: A glyph on the --icon-size-* scale, and the ONLY supported way to render a standalone one.

name: DataTable
tagline: The one TanStack-powered compound admin list — sticky header, sorting, global search, column visibility ('set view'), bulk selection, BOTH cursor and numbered pagination, density, and built-in empty/loading states.

name: Card
tagline: Surface container that requests break-inside: avoid in print, with optional accent stripe, variant fill (including the Ant Design borderless edge), hoverable lift, and density.

name: CardContent
tagline: Card body.

name: StatCard
tagline: KPI tile.

name: ServiceLauncherCard
tagline: Token-owned downstream-service launcher tile with an uploaded service logo (falling back to a semantic icon), status, metadata, action, disabled reason, matching skeleton, and companion catalog CTA.

name: ServiceCatalogCta
tagline: Dashed companion tile that closes a launcher grid with the real catalog/add route — same Card geometry as ServiceLauncherCard, no status or metadata.

name: Badge
tagline: Plain or lifecycle badge.

name: Legend
tagline: The KEY for a colour-coded surface: which tone means what, spelled out in words once — a square swatch per tone with its label.

name: Swatch
tagline: A READ-ONLY sample of ONE colour a person chose — a brand's primary_color, a calendar category, a tag tint.

name: TextDiff
tagline: What changed between two versions of a text — removed runs in <del>, added runs in <ins>, inline or side by side, per line / word / character, with CJK cut per character and long unchanged runs folded.

name: FeatureList
tagline: A list of STATEMENTS, each with a leading state glyph (included ✓ / limited − / excluded ✗), an optional wrapping description, and the glyph aligned to the first text line.

name: Persona
tagline: Compact person identity: fixed avatar, independently truncated name and muted secondary line, optional inline badge.

name: ListRow
tagline: Single-line entity row (leading · title/description · trailing action) for SHORT lists inside a Card — sessions, API tokens, linked accounts, passkeys, MFA factors, invitations.

name: CredentialReveal
tagline: One-time secret surface — masked-by-default value with a show/hide toggle, a copy button that confirms the copy, optional download, and an optional acknowledge action to pair with Dialog.

name: QrCode
tagline: Local-only SVG QR renderer for enrollment links, device pairing and other values that must never be sent to a third-party image service.

name: Descriptions
tagline: Responsive definition grid for detail-page metadata.

name: EmptyState
tagline: Centred empty placeholder with icon, title, description, and optional CTA.

name: Progress
tagline: Progress in two modes: a METER (`value` 0–100, optional tone, over-capacity striped state, drawn as a bar or — with `shape='ring'` — as an arc with the readout inside it) and a BREAKDOWN (`segments` — one total split into tone-coloured slices on a taller track).

name: CodeBlock
tagline: A block of preformatted text (request and response bodies, console output, snippets): mono, muted surface, soft-wrapped long lines by default, and an optional height cap that scrolls inside the block instead of pushing the page.

name: Markdown
tagline: The one Markdown renderer for GoDX apps (sibling package `@godxjp/markdown`, versioned with the kit): GFM + GitHub heading anchors, one sanitiser schema (no raw HTML; http/https/mailto/relative URLs only), and ```mermaid drawn only after its SVG passes a fail-closed gate (gh#1108).

name: MarkdownEditor
tagline: Markdown editor (sibling package `@godxjp/editor`, versioned with the kit): the kit's Textarea with a WAI-ARIA formatting toolbar, write / preview / side by side (preview via `@godxjp/markdown`), IME-safe ⌘/Ctrl+B·I·K, one undo step per toolbar edit, and paste / drop / attach through a host `upload` (gh#1109).

name: BlockEditor
tagline: Notion / note.com style block editor (sibling package `@godxjp/block-editor`, versioned with the kit) that reads and writes MARKDOWN through `@godxjp/markdown/codec`: what onValueChange returns is byte-for-byte normalize(body).

name: RichTextEditor
tagline: A form field that edits HTML (sibling package `@godxjp/block-editor`, gh#1365): a fixed toolbar — bold, italic, strike, inline code · H1–H3, bulleted / numbered list, quote · undo, redo — over a Tiptap surface whose SCHEMA is the sanitiser.

name: TranslatableRichText
tagline: ONE RichTextEditor holding an HTML value per locale (`{ ja, en, vi }`), switched by locale tabs (gh#1365).

name: Prose
tagline: Typography for rendered content (Markdown, CMS bodies, issue descriptions): styles the semantic HTML inside it from the tokens, with no opinion about where the HTML comes from.

name: Timeline
tagline: Vertical event list with an icon rail.

name: TimelineGrid
tagline: The time-axis half of the Timeline family: a vertical hour axis, one column per day (or room, or machine) and event blocks placed by start time and duration.

name: Table
tagline: Primitive table shell (Table/TableHeader/TableBody/TableRow/TableHead/TableCell).

name: DataState
tagline: TanStack Query lifecycle widget — skeleton / error / empty / success for one useQuery block.

name: AuthExpiryProvider
tagline: App-root handler for an expired session (401 / invalid or expired token): every DataState / InfiniteQueryState / AlertMutationFeedback / AlertQueryError calls it automatically, once, and shows a neutral pending state instead of an error alert.

name: InfiniteQueryState
tagline: useInfiniteQuery widget — flatten pages, skeleton/empty/error, load-more footer.

name: Form
tagline: Ant-style layout container — renders <form> and pushes layout (vertical/horizontal), labelWidth/controlWidth, label alignment, responsive collapse, and multi-column grid down to every FormField (overridable per field).

name: FormField
tagline: Wraps a control with label, helper, and error; injects the accessible name (aria-labelledby), description (aria-describedby) and validation (aria-errormessage/aria-invalid/aria-required) contract onto the child, which forwards it to its real semantic focus target.

name: FormErrors
tagline: The 'no field to stand on' error summary — renders the entries of the surrounding Form's server error bag that no mounted FormField name='…' claims: validation errors on hidden/derived fields (action_mode, page, a source-record id) that would otherwise fail silently.

name: Input
tagline: Styled wrapper around native <input>; accepts all HTML input attributes.

name: NumberInput
tagline: WAI-ARIA spinbutton for localized numeric entry — composes the real Input (role=spinbutton, inputMode=decimal) with stacked increment/decrement step Buttons.

name: SearchInput
tagline: Debounced search box with a clear button.

name: RecordPicker
tagline: ONE picker whose SHAPE follows the size of the set behind it: at or under `threshold` it IS a Select (dropdown with search); over it, a Dialog with search + consumer-declared filters, chips, and a confirm step for `multiple`.

name: Select
tagline: Polymorphic single-select: pass options/loadOptions for the data-driven (Ant-style) API, or compose sub-parts manually — never use a raw <select>.

name: Switch
tagline: Toggle switch (bare), on react-aria-components.

name: Textarea
tagline: Styled wrapper around native <textarea>.

name: TranslatableInput
tagline: ONE text field holding a value per locale (`{ ja, en, vi }`), switched by locale tabs above it (gh#1336).

name: TranslatableTextarea
tagline: TranslatableInput over a Textarea (gh#1336): one multi-line field holding a value per locale, switched by locale tabs.

name: TranslatableField
tagline: The locale-tab engine behind TranslatableInput, TranslatableTextarea and `@godxjp/block-editor`'s TranslatableRichText (gh#1365): the locale list and first tab (AppProvider `contentLocales`), the per-locale map, the fallback placeholder, the error marks and the FormField error report — around ONE control you render with `renderControl`.

name: Label
tagline: Styled React Aria Label; use htmlFor to associate with a control.

name: Checkbox
tagline: Checkbox on react-aria-components; standalone or via CheckboxGroup with an options array.

name: RadioGroup
tagline: Radio group accepting an options array or RadioItem children.

name: DatePicker
tagline: ONE date control: `picker` sets the granularity (day · week · month · quarter · year), `range` makes it a two-endpoint field, `multiple` a set.

name: Dialog
tagline: Compound modal.

name: AlertDialog
tagline: Canonical modal confirmation flow (destructive / high-stakes decisions).

name: Sheet
tagline: Side-panel drawer / responsive detail panel (React Aria modal dialog).

name: Alert
tagline: Status message with a tone icon and optional dismiss, in three presentations: inline card, full-bleed page/shell strip (`variant="banner"`), or a non-live aside inside a document (`variant="callout"`, GitHub `> [!NOTE]`).

name: Toaster
tagline: Mount once at app root to enable toasts.

name: Tabs
tagline: React Aria tab container with optional Ant-style `items` API.

name: Pagination
tagline: Offset/page-based pagination bar.

name: DropdownMenu
tagline: Dropdown menu (react-aria).

name: Steps
tagline: Multi-step progress indicator — horizontal or vertical, default or dot style.

name: Toolbar
tagline: List-page filter strip — SearchInput + labelled ToolbarGroup filter slots (or the typed `search`/`filters`/`chips` model) + a clear-all affordance, optionally sticky.

name: SearchForm
tagline: Submit-driven 「検索条件フォーム」 (Ant Design ProComponents QueryFilter): a `search` landmark holding a grid of labelled conditions aligned in columns, Search 「検索」 + Clear 「クリア」, the conditions past the first row behind ONE 「詳細条件を開く」 toggle that names how many are hidden, and a 「検索条件」 summary + result count in a role="status" line after the search.

name: AppProvider
tagline: Root locale/timezone/date-time context — wrap the app ONCE.

name: OverlayPortalProvider
tagline: Moves EVERY overlay in this library (Popover, Dialog, Sheet, Tooltip, DropdownMenu, HoverCard, Select, Cascader) into a container you name — the one thing an app mounted inside a SHADOW ROOT cannot do with props.

name: ThemeScope
tagline: Makes a themed REGION reach the overlays it opens.

name: formatDate
tagline: MANDATORY for all date/time display.

name: TimePicker
tagline: Time combobox with hours, minutes, optional seconds, confirmation and 12-hour formatting.

name: Cascader
tagline: Multi-level hierarchical path picker (Popover + cascading columns); value is always a string[] path, never a flat ID — passing a bare string breaks it.

name: TreeSelect
tagline: Hierarchical tree picker in a Popover (single or multi-select with checkboxes) — `onValueChange` receives `string` in single mode and `string[]` in multi/checkable mode; never use a raw `<select>` for tree-structured data.

name: Transfer
tagline: Dual-list shuttle that moves items between source and target via Checkbox selection — you own targetKeys state; never hand-roll a two-panel picker.

name: Upload
tagline: Drag-and-drop / button / avatar / picture file uploader in six variants — wire onUpload to your media-service and call collectUploadCommitActions on form submit; supports multipart forms and custom media storage.

name: UploadCropDialog
tagline: Modal crop dialog for a single image file — always controlled (open + file + onConfirm required); do NOT use standalone when Upload variant="avatar-crop" already embeds it.

name: ColorPicker
tagline: Native color-swatch picker with an optional editable hex input — always pass a valid 3- or 6-digit hex `value`; invalid hex is silently ignored and the previous value is restored.

name: Slider
tagline: Numeric slider on react-aria-components with the antd 6 API — one thumb over a point, or `range` for a span.

name: Calendar
tagline: A styled react-day-picker grid for picking single dates, multiple dates, or date ranges — always embed it inside a Popover for full date-picker UX; use DatePicker (add `range` for a from/to pair) instead when you need a form-submittable input.

name: Command
tagline: Accessible, keyboard-navigable command palette / combobox list built on cmdk — always pair CommandInput inside its own wrapper div, never render items outside CommandList.

name: CheckboxGroup
tagline: Multi-select checkbox list from an options array or manual children — use `options` prop for the data-driven path, never hand-roll individual Checkbox items in a group.

name: Radio
tagline: Radio group on react-aria-components, with an options-array shorthand — always use Radio.Group, never a bare radio input.

name: Popover
tagline: React Aria floating panel anchored to a trigger — always compose with PopoverTrigger + PopoverContent; never use a raw div overlay.

name: ScrollArea
tagline: Keyboard focus on the scroll viewport and its descendants uses the shared inset brand ring (--focus-ring-inset-offset), without padding changes.

name: Collapsible
tagline: Three-part compound (Collapsible + CollapsibleTrigger + CollapsibleContent) that toggles a region open/closed — never use just one part alone.

name: Tree
tagline: The standalone WAI-ARIA tree view on a page (antd `Tree` / `DirectoryTree`) — nested `treeData`, a disclosure triangle per branch, roving-tabindex arrow navigation, optional tri-state checkboxes, async `loadData` and `draggable` reorder/reparent (antd `onDrop`).

name: Tooltip
tagline: React Aria hover/focus tooltip — self-providing, no app-level TooltipProvider required; compose Tooltip > TooltipTrigger > TooltipContent every time.

name: PrefetchLink
tagline: React Router Link that fires prefetchQuery on hover/focus so detail pages feel instant — requires a TanStack Query QueryClient in context.

name: Avatar
tagline: Avatar mark with image and fallback slots for users, teams, and entities.

name: Separator
tagline: Tokenized horizontal or vertical rule, optionally INTERRUPTED by a localized label (day divider, unread watermark, auth conjunction).

name: Skeleton
tagline: Base pulsing skeleton block, the namespace the presets hang off (Skeleton.Input / .Article), and the ONE entry for every loading shape: SkeletonTable / SkeletonRows / SkeletonDetail / SkeletonStat / SkeletonArticle / SkeletonInput / SkeletonForm.

name: Toggle
tagline: React Aria toggle button with default/outline/soft variants and tokenized sizes.

name: ToggleGroup
tagline: Single or multiple toggle selection on react-aria-components.

name: AspectRatio
tagline: Fixed-ratio box (CSS aspect-ratio) for stable media and preview frames.

name: Accordion
tagline: React Aria disclosure group — vertically stacked, collapsible sections.

name: PasswordInput
tagline: Input for passwords with a built-in show/hide eye toggle.

name: PasswordStrength
tagline: Evaluates password quality with a 0-4 score and optional rule checklist.

name: InputOTP
tagline: One-time-code / 2FA input (input-otp) — N single-character slots that behave as one field.

name: Rating
tagline: Star-rating input (radiogroup) — controlled via value/onValueChange, form-submittable via name, supports readOnly display.

name: Segmented
tagline: One-of-N from a small, closed, always-visible set — the enterprise Segmented / filter bar drawn on react-aria-components' RadioGroup.

name: ResizablePanel
tagline: Resizable panel group/child/handle primitives from react-resizable-panels.

name: Carousel
tagline: Embla-backed carousel primitives: previous/next controls, CarouselDots indicators, and a context API.

name: AppSettingPicker
tagline: One provider-bound Select for a single AppProvider setting, chosen by `kind` (locale | timezone | dateFormat | timeFormat | theme | brand | density | fontSize) — covers locale/format AND the four theme axes.

name: Field
tagline: Label + optional description laid out beside a single checkbox/radio/switch control — the inline alternative to FormField's full block layout.

name: LineChart
tagline: Trends over an ordered category axis — one or more series, locale-formatted ticks/tooltips, screen-reader text alternative built in.

name: BarChart
tagline: Compare a value across categories — grouped or `stacked`, vertical or `horizontal`, with localized ticks/tooltips and a built-in text alternative.

name: CompactBarTrend
tagline: DEPENDENCY-FREE compact vertical bar trend for dashboard summary cards — N category/value pairs, muted marks plus ONE emphasized 'current' bar, all geometry from --chart-trend-* tokens.

name: HeatmapChart
tagline: DEPENDENCY-FREE rows × columns heatmap — weekday × hour revenue / order counts, cell intensity from the sequential CVD-safe --chart-heat-1..5 ramp.

name: AreaChart
tagline: Magnitude over an ordered category axis — overlay or `stacked` areas, optional `curved` smoothing, localized formatting + text alternative.

name: PieChart
tagline: Part-to-whole composition across a small set of slices — `donut` option, localized tooltips, and a screen-reader breakdown of every slice.

name: CommandPalette
tagline: Searchable command dialog with controlled or uncontrolled open state and consumer-owned selection.

name: EmojiPicker
tagline: Page icon / reaction picker in a Popover (gh#1164): search by the active language's CLDR keywords (ja / en / vi — emojibase-data, loaded lazily for that locale only), categories, per-user recents, a WAI-ARIA grid (one tab stop, arrows, Home / End, Enter), and "remove icon".

name: DashboardGrid
tagline: BI widget layout editor with deterministic push-down collisions and vertical compaction.

name: SortableList
tagline: Reorder a flat list or a grid of tiles (gh#1173).

name: TwoFactorSetup
tagline: Canonical two-factor enrollment dialog for QR/manual-key verification and recovery-code acknowledgement.

name: AuthDivider
tagline: The auth-scoped PRESET over `Separator label` — a localized conjunction between two equal rules.

name: AuthFooter
tagline: Compact hosted-auth footer for consumer-owned product, legal, privacy, and locale content.

name: AuthIdentity
tagline: Hosted-auth identity heading with the shared mark (or the product's own lockup) and optional requesting-client context.

name: AccountChip
tagline: Signed-in user for a PageContainer extra slot, Topbar or footer row: avatar, name and one ghost action at the control tier height — never a hand-rolled rounded-full border div.

name: AuthAccountSummary
tagline: Compact signed-in account row for hosted auth: avatar fallback, authoritative email and switch action.

name: AuthStack
tagline: Token-spaced vertical stack for direct sections inside a canonical auth card.

name: OrgSwitcher
tagline: Searchable organization switcher with canonical trigger geometry, desktop popover, and mobile sheet.

name: AppLauncher
tagline: Nine-dot topbar app grid — the platform-standard way to switch app (the Google Workspace shape).

name: PermissionMatrix
tagline: Domain data is 100% consumer-supplied.

name: BranchScopePicker
tagline: Canonical scope control: all branches vs an explicit subset.

name: ServiceRolePanel
tagline: Geometry (1440/1024 two-track, 390 stacked) is MasterDetail's tokens.

name: ChatBubble
tagline: One message in a conversation: an author mark, a header naming the turn, the body, and a footer.

name: ChatBubbleList
tagline: The message feed.

name: ChatComposer
tagline: The message input of a conversation (Ant Design X Sender): an auto-growing Textarea plus exactly ONE trailing action — send, or cancel while a response streams.

name: ChatSuggestion
tagline: In @godxjp/chat since v32, not @godxjp/ui: add @godxjp/chat as a dependency at the same version as @godxjp/ui.

name: Conversations
tagline: The session rail of a chat surface (Ant Design X Conversations): past conversations, the current one marked with aria-current, a per-row overflow menu, and recency buckets — the whole rail one roving-tabindex tab stop, not one tab stop per conversation.

name: MegaMenu
tagline: A primary site navigation whose top-level items disclose a full-width panel of grouped links (Ant Design `Menu mode="horizontal"` whose SubMenu renders through popupRender).

name: Welcome
tagline: The greeting block at the head of an empty conversation (Ant Design X Welcome): glyph, greeting, one line under it, and a trailing slot ON THE TITLE ROW — which is the placement a hand-roll gets wrong.

name: Actions
tagline: The strip of actions under an assistant message (Ant Design X Actions): copy, retry, like, and a menu for the rest — a WAI-ARIA toolbar with ONE tab stop, where Ant X's own strip is <div onClick> with no role and no accessible name.

name: ThoughtChain
tagline: The assistant's reasoning, step by step (Ant Design X ThoughtChain): an ORDERED list of steps, each with an ordinal or a glyph, a status, and a body it can collapse — where Ant X's own step is a <div onClick> with no role and no aria-expanded.

name: OrgChart
tagline: An organization chart: boxes (avatar, name, title, extra) joined by CSS connector lines, top-down; `agent` nodes are dashed.

name: Image
tagline: antd `Image` + `Image.PreviewGroup`: a picture that opens in a full-viewport preview (zoom in/out by button, wheel or double-click; rotate; flip; reset; drag to pan).

name: Attachments
tagline: The chat-surface attachment collection (Ant Design X Attachments): file cards, inline placeholder, optional full-screen drop target, and ref.select/ref.upload — inherits antd Upload props but names the list `items`.

name: Marquee
tagline: A track of content that travels continuously, carrying the WCAG 2.2.2 pause control that makes it conformant.

name: Masonry
tagline: Ant Design `Masonry` (6.0.0): tiles of UNEQUAL height packed into columns, each tile dropped into whichever column is shortest when its turn comes.

name: Affix
tagline: Ant Design `Affix` (6.6.5): pin an element to its scrollport once the page scrolls past it, and REPORT that it is pinned.

name: Anchor
tagline: Ant Design `Anchor` (6.6.5): the in-page section navigation, and the only thing in this library that COMPUTES which section is current.
